purpose: One source control for every Plan line: who said it (a person, organization or AI agent record), the document or decision it came from, or words for someone with no record yet.
namedChanges: `useShell()` (lines 64 and 105) is `host.useShell()`; `heldVaultIds(...)` (106) is `host.heldVaultIds(...)`; `useQuery({ ...STAKEHOLDER_TYPE_SET_QUERY, enabled: editing })` (107) is `host.useStakeholderTypes(editing)`; `useVaultFilesMulti(...)` (109) is `host.useVaultFilesMulti(...)`; `matchWorkingSetQuery(items, text)` (55) is `host.matchWorkingSetQuery(items, text)`; `findStakeholderRecords(...)` (115) is `host.findStakeholderRecords(...)`; `readRecord(...)` (221) is `host.readRecord(...)`; `memberEntityUri(...)` (222) is `host.memberEntityUri(...)`; `<ConnectedCreateDialog ...>` (210) is `<host.ConnectedCreateDialog ...>` with the same props. Nine host members, each in the source's place and order. The host reaches the component by `PlanSourceHostContext`: a private hook `usePlanSourceHost()` reads it (twice a render: in `useOpen` and in `PlanSource`) and throws an error that names the provider when there is none.

`documentHits(files, text)` (line 43) takes the host first, `documentHits(host, files, text)`, and its call (117) passes `host`, so that it can call `host.matchWorkingSetQuery`; the file type `VaultFileWithSource` is `PlanSourceFile`, declared beside the host (`id`, `sourceVaultId`, `typeUri?`, `name`, `updatedAt`, `entityUri?`).
The dependency arrays of `useMemo` and `useCallback` are unchanged: they do not list the host, which must be the same object for as long as the provider is mounted.
